items.text: Chest drain system set-up, monitoring and emergencies follow the unit's approved procedure and the inserting team's instructions. No source for the steps has been read.

checklist.text: Check the patient's breathing and the drain system against the unit's procedure.
Call for help for respiratory distress, sudden change in drainage or a disconnected system per unit protocol.
Record drainage, air leak status and patient response per unit standard.
